races.paceDynamic: Mo Ghille Mar, Leave In Secret, and Claude will fight for the lead from the off, guaranteeing a genuine end-to-end gallop over 2m1f on Yielding ground at Ballinrobe — a track that already had ground softening through the card to full Yielding by this slot. Eight runners in total want prominent positions, meaning the early exchanges will be contested and energy-sapping, with significant traffic danger building as the field compresses approaching the final two fences. The Yielding surface amplifies stamina demands, and a true pace will expose any runner who lacks the reserves to sustain effort from two out. This race shape overwhelmingly favours genuine hold-up horses and midfielders who can travel economically off a hot tempo and produce a clean late run — front-runners burning fuel in a three-way battle for the lead are unlikely to last home, and prominent racers caught in congestion risk losing momentum at the critical stage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Late
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Ghille Mar, Leave In Secret, and Claude burn each other out over a genuine Yielding-ground gallop, stamina-rich hold-up types finishing late are the primary beneficiaries.
scenarios.body: The three leaders set a punishing pace that drains the prominent runners, leaving the field strung out by the third-last; horses who have tracked wide of the congestion and conserved energy sweep through in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survives Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace battle between the three leaders burns out two of them early, one front-runner or close-tracking prominent horse steals a crucial breather mid-race and holds on.
scenarios.body: A prominent runner who manages to sit just off the lead without being embroiled in the three-way battle can find a rhythm over the Yielding ground and prove too far clear for the hold-up horses closing late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse; Closers Outrun
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed leaders either slow the pace after a frantic opening or unseat early, the race resets to a tactical crawl that suits a hold-up horse with a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: A more moderate tempo paradoxically lets a hold-up runner coast within striking range and produce an effective turn of foot from the last fence, though Yielding ground limits the pure speedsters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Grinder Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the stamina test becomes truly extreme and the Yielding ground takes a severe toll, a low-key midfield type with proven form on soft surfaces grinds past tiring rivals on the run-in.
scenarios.body: Horses with a history of placing on soft or yielding ground and the ability to keep finding under pressure outclass rivals who have peaked too soon in the race.

watchPoints.text: Mo Ghille Mar, Leave In Secret, and Claude will fight three-wide for the lead from the off — watch for one of them being shuffled sideways at the first fence, potentially bringing down prominent horses caught in the scramble.

Eight runners mapped prominent or leading into a field of 19 means severe congestion two-to-three out at Ballinrobe's tight turning track — Stoneyford Lady and Lady Doyanne are both prominent types at risk of being squeezed for room at the critical stage.

Le Diablo is the scorecard selection but a form string ending 523074 and a claiming jockey (Kevin Healy, 4lb) on a hold-up horse in a 19-runner field means a clean passage from the rear is not guaranteed — a traffic incident two out could cost him the race.

The going officially drifted to Yielding by the 6:40 slot after earlier races were run on Good To Yielding — horses with proven form on soft or yielding ground (Roccabaker, Sayitfirst, Stoneyford Lady) hold an empirical edge over those unproven in these conditions.

Three De Bromhead runners (Stoneyford Lady, Lady Doyanne, Fedneys Park) in the same race with the yard firing (T14:4/24) — watch market moves for stable instructions, as one of the three will likely receive riding orders to take up the prominent berth while others are covered up.

runners_data.name: Iron Sword
runners_data.comment: Placed third last time out after a fifth two starts back, Iron Sword brings solid recent form into this and has run over today's trip; winless in his last two starts, but as the top-rated runner carrying 157 lb, he shapes as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Walkineezy
runners_data.comment: Walkineezy has run over today's trip and going, and our rating ranks him second of the six, making him a genuine threat to the top-rated runner — though he is winless in recent starts, his trainer is yet to land a winner from 25 attempts in the last 14 days, which is the concern.

runners_data.name: Le Grand Retour
runners_data.comment: Debut runner with an open profile, Le Grand Retour arrives unexposed and open to improvement; carrying 157 lb on his first start, there is plenty left to discover about this gelding.

runners_data.name: Gaelic Seer
runners_data.comment: Unexposed on debut, Gaelic Seer arrives unraced and open to considerable improvement, making her an intriguing unknown quantity as she steps into the ring for the first time carrying 150 lb.

runners_data.name: Real Lark
runners_data.comment: Unexposed on debut, Real Lark arrives without a public form line to assess but remains open to significant improvement as connections reveal her hand for the first time, carrying 150 lb.

runners_data.name: Reafadda
runners_data.comment: Reafadda has run over today's trip and going and, rated 76 in this field of six, shapes as a genuine danger on his day, though consecutive sixth-place finishes leave him winless in recent starts and that consistency question is his main risk.
